rules.title: Residential rental property application fee not to exceed $50
rules.requirement: A landlord or its agent may not require an application or similar fee above $50 to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property. Starting January 1 of the year after enactment, the cap is adjusted each year for CPI increases. Violations carry penalties of up to $500, $750 and $1,000.
rules.quoted_span:
1. a. A landlord, or
agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply
to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which
exceeds $50.

Licensee of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission, unless the licensee is the landlord of the residential rental property

coverage.notes: Applies to fees for applying to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes.

rules.coverage_text: Landlords and their agents who charge application or similar fees to apply to lease or sublease residential rental property for dwelling purposes.
rules.exemptions: Does not apply to (1) a dwelling unit in a one-family or two-family dwelling offered for rent, or (2) a licensee of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission, unless the licensee is the landlord of the property.
